shortDesc.message: Visual gallery wall layout generator and photo collage planner: try frame sizes on wall, arrange pictures, get nail marks.

storeDesc.message:
🖼️ Gallery Wall Layout Generator plans a group of frames in the Chrome side panel. Pick a layout, see every print at true scale in your room, and get a numbered spot for each nail before you drill a single hole.

This gallery wall layout generator with sizes works on its own. The room, the plan and the nail marks stay in the panel, next to the page you are reading.

🚀 How it works in four steps:
1. Click the toolbar button to open the side panel.
2. Take a photo of your room or start in the demo room, then set the scale.
3. Choose one of five templates and set the gap.
4. Open Nail marks and copy the numbered positions.

📐 Gallery wall layout ideas to start from:
1️⃣ Row of three: three prints side by side, for a bed or a console.
2️⃣ Grid of four: an even block for prints of one size.
3️⃣ Grid of nine: a big block for a hallway or a stairwell.
4️⃣ One big, two on each side: the classic art gallery wall layout over a sofa.
5️⃣ Two rows: a low, wide wall collage layout for a long sideboard or a TV.

These gallery wall templates open with standard sizes. Change any of them, add your own up to 12, and drag them into place. Each one snaps into line, so the gallery wall layout generator keeps your picture frame layout neat.

🧱 Try before you buy:
▸ See each print at true scale on a photo of your own room.
▸ Check poster sizes on wall next to your sofa, bed or desk.
▸ Use it as an art visualizer and frame visualizer for prints you already own.
▸ Switch between inches and centimetres at any time.

🛒 Found a print or a frame in an online store? Right-click the image and choose Try on my wall. The art hangs at true size in your saved room, so you know it fits before you order. It works as a size visualizer for prints and posters.

📏 What the gallery wall planner measures for you:
➤ The width and height of the whole group, updated as you move frames.
➤ The distance from the group to each side, the ceiling and the floor.
➤ A numbered map with a table: right, down and up from the floor for every nail.
➤ Every length rounded to ¼ in or a whole centimetre.
➤ A warning when the group runs wider than the space or too close to the ceiling or floor.

🔧 Hangers on the back:
① One nail: type the drop from the top edge to the hanging point.
② Two D-rings: type the drop and the inset of each ring from the side.
③ A mix: give each piece its own hanger. The type you pick carries over to the next piece, so you pick it once for a run of D-ring prints.

💡 Picture hanging ideas built into the planner:
- Leave 2 to 3 in (5 to 8 cm) between frames.
- Hang the group about 8 in (20 cm) above a sofa or a headboard.
- With no furniture below, put the centre of the group 57 in (145 cm) from the floor.
- Keep the group about two thirds as wide as the furniture under it.

These four rules answer how to hang pictures and how high to hang pictures, and the default layout already follows them. Change the gap and the group is laid out again.

🎨 Use it as a gallery wall template generator, or to sketch picture frame wall ideas and wall collages before you shop.

🏠 Who uses this generator:
• Renters who want one set of holes, in the right place.
• Anyone doing a diy gallery wall with family photos and prints.
• People arranging photos around a TV or over a bed.
• Designers who need a gallery wall layout with sizes for a client.

❓ How do I use the gallery wall layout planner?
💡 Open the gallery wall layout generator, pick a template, set the gap and drag the pieces until it looks right. Then open Nail marks.

❓ How far apart should pictures be?
💡 2 to 3 inches (5 to 8 cm) suits most groups. You can set any gap from 0 to 12 in.

❓ Can I use a photo of my own room?
💡 Yes. Take a photo, set the scale, and everything shows at true scale on it.

❓ What wall art sizes work over a sofa?
💡 A group about two thirds as wide as the sofa. The gallery wall layout generator shows the group's width as you go, so it doubles as a wall art size guide.

❓ Can I mix photos and prints in one collage?
💡 Yes. Give each piece its own hanger, and the gallery wall layout generator numbers every nail.

❓ Does it work with frames I already have?
💡 Yes. Type their sizes. A layout holds up to 12.

❓ Where do the nails go?
💡 The Nail marks view numbers each one and gives its distance from your start point and from the floor.

🎯 Add Gallery Wall Layout Generator to Chrome and plan your next set of frames from the side panel.

Official website: https://framesizes.app/
